utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the exact issue and where the repair drive is headed? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m not totally sure on the exact issue right now, but I can check and get back to you. The repair drive is headed to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Cleo — I can lend a hand and a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — we could really use extra tape, screws, and a sturdy hammer if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key today.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s perfectly fine — low-key is great. I’ll work around your schedule and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, sorry I’m late — did I miss the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Dane — you didn’t miss it. I’m just gathering the last few details, and I’ll fill you in now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m in. Tell me when and where the repair drive is, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you make it this Saturday at 10 by the community center?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh great, can you handle a quick flyer run and check who still needs pickup help?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help however I can with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing—could you help spread the word and maybe bring a few tools or supplies if you have them?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m tracking the repair drive locations, Oren—what spot are we starting with?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks for keeping track, Opal. We should start wherever the folks said the tools are piled up first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll swing by after lunch and we can load up the donations together. Be ready around two, and I’ll bring the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—people around here have been talking about it. If you know the details, I’d love the update.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I don’t know the exact details yet, but I can check and let you know. It sounds like it’ll be a helpful drive for the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on for today — folks are meeting up this afternoon. I’ll send word if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the schedule and where we’re dropping everything off first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — we’re aiming for Saturday morning, and we’ll drop everything off at the community center on Oak Street first.
